policies.metric_assumption: Eligible row-level evidence is still an event candidate, not a canonical event.
policies.proxy_risk: Surface rows may include paired, qualifier, administrative, derived or duplicate-reflection records.
policies.denominator_risk: Not applicable for the count itself; comparison scope still requires declaration.
policies.sample_risk: Small and provider-specific samples limit generalisation.
policies.context_risk: Missing match state and scope prevent contextual interpretation.
policies.safe_interpretation: Row-level surface evidence count after declared eligibility filters.

policies.metric_assumption: Provider and version definitions determine numerator, denominator and success criteria.
policies.proxy_risk: The same label can represent different inclusion, exclusion, set-piece and success policies.
policies.denominator_risk: Unknown or incompatible opportunity sets invalidate comparison.
policies.sample_risk: Unbalanced samples can make descriptive differences unstable.
policies.context_risk: Entity, period and observation-window mismatch invalidates comparison.
policies.safe_interpretation: Provider-bound descriptive rate candidate with explicit definition.

policies.metric_assumption: Admitted event start/end coordinates describe provider event geometry only.
policies.proxy_risk: Event endpoints do not reveal continuous player positions, defender geometry, off-ball movement or true occupied space.
policies.denominator_risk: Not applicable to an action-level descriptor; aggregate comparisons still require a declared eligible action set.
policies.sample_risk: Sparse or selectively tagged event endpoints can distort aggregate geometry summaries.
policies.context_risk: Coordinate direction, pitch normalization and event semantic role must be admitted before interpretation.
policies.safe_interpretation: Provider-coordinate displacement, direction and zone-transition candidate for an admitted event surface.
